The final showdown erupted outside the championship hall. Bryce and the Hogs of War arrived from one direction while MWM attacked from the other, creating the sort of massive brawl normally reserved for season finales. ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Well it feels like GW thinks this is a problem, or maybe they just particularly hate melee armies…  Or maybe just me personally.  I mean it feels personal at this point.

I am so sick of feeling like if you have effective guns you get a discount on the points for your data sheet.  And Psychic…  Don’t get me started.   Basically if you are a coward and don’t have to play 40K but are dominant, you are cheaper than units that risk themselves to be effective.  Then there are nonsense pointed armies, WTH.  Look at Goats on disks in TSons, Necrons, or how all the Flying Battle Suits in Tau are vastly more broken and yet in some cases cheaper, and you will see why I am angry, and feel like MFM points are irrational.  Hell just look at the units that got discounts in SM but went up for BA making an even higher point differential even though there are only 2 (3DP, don’t get me started, why bother having 1DPs at all???) detachments (not the faction rule) that justify those points increases.  So if you do try to pivot and do something cool, well you’re paying more for less.  Which is just a kick in the teeth after being punched in the nuts at almost every opportunity in 10th.  I mean I have hope that maybe they will fix some of this and the all the fundamental underlying issues of edition change…  But really?

You can all play clearly broken and abusive lists, with points issued so glaringly obvious that Interns who have only played a handful of games should have caught, and yet people paid to think of the health of this game missed, or thought was fine.  I don’t know what to say about that.

Actually I do.  You are all cowards.

Rather than wallowing in any of the rank stupidity of launch, I am just going to rip your face off and make the problem worse.  Hopefully I can earn the faction that I have lovingly played for nine editions now, some more unnecessary nerfs.  Because that is who I am.

For Honor!  For the Blood!  For Sanguineous!

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

When Jon—custodian of the team’s only painted Knight Lance—catastrophically soils himself on the morning of the ATC, hype man Bryce drags legendary coach Don out of retirement to save the newly rebranded Hogs of War. Driven by sponsor obligations and a burning desire to crush his old nemesis Brent, Don rounds up a ragtag crew of misfits—including a mathhammer oracle, a speed-painting demon, and a movement tray surgeon—to pull off an impossible 60-hour heist: assemble, paint, list-tune, and captain an unmeta army to victory. Drilling his players on "The 60-Second Turn" to dominate the clock, Don masterfully manipulates the pairing matrices and navigates judge disputes, cold dice, and hotel rooms stained with Agrax Earthshade. In a high-stakes streaming finale against Brent’s precision gunline, Don flips the attacker sequence and rallies his team to "win ugly" on secondaries, flipping a crucial objective as the clock hits zero to secure the championship trophy by a mere three points.
